units.source_text: 写得并不特别用心，但源氏大将看了觉得异常高雅优美，想是心理作用之故。

en.t: It was not written with any particular care, but when General Genji looked at it, he found it extraordinarily elegant and beautiful, perhaps because his feelings influenced him.

units.source_text: 她的书体并不特异，也不时髦，然而自有与众不同的优点。

en.t: Her handwriting was neither unusual nor fashionable, yet it had a distinctive merit all its own.

units.source_text: 源氏大将今天摒除了一切恋情，只是跟着融雪的水滴一同流泪，专心诵经礼佛。

en.t: Today General Genji set aside all thoughts of love, wept only along with the drops of melting snow, and devoted himself to sutra recitation and worship of the Buddha.
